description: This Java class defines the ShoppingCartData entity used to represent shopping cart information in a web-based e-commerce application. It contains fields like message, code, quantity, total, subtotal, and lists of shopping cart items and order totals, with corresponding getter and setter methods.
external_methods: ShopEntity's methods (if any are used or overridden)
